parameters.query: WITH article_upsert AS (INSERT INTO articles (article_id, canonical_url, source, title, published_at_utc, expires_at_utc) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz, $5::timestamptz + interval '72 hours') ON CONFLICT (canonical_url) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, published_at_utc = EXCLUDED.published_at_utc, expires_at_utc = EXCLUDED.expires_at_utc, updated_at_utc = now() RETURNING id), content_state AS (SELECT article_upsert.id AS article_id, existing.content_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM md5($8) AS content_changed FROM article_upsert LEFT JOIN article_contents AS existing ON existing.article_id = article_upsert.id), content_upsert AS (INSERT INTO article_contents (article_id, markdown_uri, metadata_uri, content_fingerprint, content_bytes, status, stored_at_utc) SELECT article_id, $6, $7, md5($8), length($8), 'stored', now() FROM content_state ON CONFLICT (article_id) DO UPDATE SET markdown_uri = EXCLUDED.markdown_uri, metadata_uri = EXCLUDED.metadata_uri, content_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.content_fingerprint, content_bytes = EXCLUDED.content_bytes, status = 'stored', stored_at_utc = now(), last_error = NULL, updated_at_utc = now() RETURNING article_id) INSERT INTO article_classification_jobs (article_id, status) SELECT content_upsert.article_id, 'pending' FROM content_upsert JOIN content_state USING (article_id) WHERE content_state.content_changed ON CONFLICT (article_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'pending', attempts = 0, lock_token = NULL, locked_at_utc = NULL, last_error = NULL, latest_classification_id = NULL, updated_at_utc = now();

## 01 — Ingesta editorial

Guarda un Markdown y metadatos JSON en Nextcloud antes de registrar `content_status=stored` y `classification_status=pending` en PostgreSQL.

Crea antes `/n8n-youtube-automation/Honi-News/Dexerto-Articles`. La clasificación se realiza en el workflow 02.
